title: The Flannan Isles Lighthouse Mystery
hook: In December 1900, three keepers vanished from Flannan Isles Lighthouse, Scotland, without a trace.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: The lighthouse, built 1899, housed three keepers: James Ducat, Thomas Marshall, Donald McArthur.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: On 26 December, the relief crew found the door open and the logbook gone.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: A half-eaten meal and wet footprints led from the stairs to the cliffs.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: Weather logs show a gale on 15 December with waves battering the island's shore.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: One theory says the men were swept away by the storm while securing equipment.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A 2021 review revealed a hidden diary entry hinting at an internal dispute.

end.line: What really happened on that bleak December night?

description: The mysterious disappearance of three lighthouse keepers in 1900.

facts.claim: Flannan Isles Lighthouse was completed in 1899.
The three keepers were James Ducat, Thomas Marshall, and Donald McArthur.
The relief crew arrived on 26 December 1900 and found the door open and the logbook missing.
A severe gale was recorded on 15 December 1900 with high seas around the islands.
Investigators in 2021 reported finding an unseen diary entry suggesting internal conflict.
Wet footprints and a half-eaten meal were discovered by the relief crew.
Flannan Isles are located in the Outer Hebrides, Scotland, in the North Atlantic.
